item.title: 20260628 Griz 8 Months Tracking
item.description: So here we are at 8 months. I think she could do articles on the track fine, but we have seperated articles for now. So this is a short track with 3 corners. She has a few moments where she tracks a little to the south, this is because of the wind blowing.

item.title: Griz 5 Months Air Scent
item.description:
Air Scent

All this was filmed on her 3rd day of air scent training. This training has nothing to do with IGP. If anything, it’s going to make the tracking portion of IGP harder. That being said, working air scent and trailing exercises is a ton of fun, and has lots of practical uses outside of the sport of IGP

In the future

We’ll be getting some better video footage of this next week. We are going on a camping trip where we will start using this training for hide and seek with the kid. And I’ll be taking her out on off trail hikes, dropping the jacket as a marker at the camp site, then having her lead me back.

item.title: Tracking 3 Dogs Begginer
item.description:
Tracking

The video is sped up by 300% in an attempt to not be so boring. 1st we have my pup, Griz. She is doing her 1st corner. She probably has the most practice at this drill out of all 3 dogs.

Then we have Argos, Griz’s big brother. His nose is killer, he’s wicked smart and here we have a short clip of him tracking in the mud. His nose is fine but we went to the mud so we could bring his attention to every footstep.

item.title: Griz 5 Months Tracking

item.title: Detection 1
item.description: In this video I’m still trying to figure out a style of video I want to make. Look how tiny she is!!! This was something I used to do with my old dog. The scent that we decide on here doesn’t matter. If you have something specific to work on like narcotics then by all means, train with that. I’ve found that it’s pretty easy to introduce new smells later. My last dog could be turned onto a new scent with 2-3 reps of making it super easy. For IGP we are going to need her to use her nose in a different way; however, this is an easy way to work the nose every day.
